response.overview: An eccentric named Antos lives in the remote countryside. He has a cherished dream: to make wings and soar into the sky like the legendary Icarus. Amidst the rush of days filled with caring for his large family, he finds a free moment and immerses himself in his favorite pastime: crafting wings in his workshop so he can one day fly.
response.title: Рондо – каприччиозо
